title: Model Evaluation Report Compiler
description: Compiles model evaluation scripts and reports. Enforces test-set-only evaluation, multiple metrics (not just accuracy), baseline comparison, confusion matrix or residual plots, confidence intervals, and documented findings. Guards against data leakage in evaluation.

error_codes.ME002: Evaluation uses training or validation data — must evaluate on held-out test set only
error_codes.ME003: Test set fit/transformed separately — leaks test distribution into evaluation
error_codes.ME004: Only accuracy/MSE reported — need F1/precision/recall (classification) or MAE/R² (regression)
error_codes.ME005: No baseline model comparison (DummyClassifier/DummyRegressor or simple heuristic)
error_codes.ME006: No confusion matrix (classification) or residual analysis (regression)
error_codes.ME007: No confidence intervals or uncertainty quantification
error_codes.ME008: Model performance findings not documented in markdown/report
